headline: EU gives Italy the go-ahead to activate the national escape clause for defence and energy | No risk
summary: The European Union has given the green light to Italy's request to activate the national escape clause for spending on defence and energy.
why: The EU fiscal escape clause lets member states exceed standard budget constraints for specified spending. It affects how investors assess Italian public finances and government bond supply.
